name: cortico-world-coo-control
description: 控制权回交：让 Coopanion 桌宠的点击、摸头与待机默认行为按人设/用户概率策略执行，并给 AI 读写策略的工具。A Cortico World that patches the installed desktop-pet body with a hot-reloadable behavior policy, backups, restore and a safe update path. 作者 funst，QQ 2674459204。

zh.description: 让桌宠的点击、摸头与待机默认行为按人设和用户设定的概率执行；AI 可经同意调整策略。会修改已安装的 Coopanion 桌宠 body.js（先备份、可还原），更新后自动重打；不匹配的新代码会拒绝而不是猜。作者 funst，QQ 2674459204，MIT 协议。

en.description: Makes the desktop pet's default click, petting and idle behaviour follow a persona/user probability policy, with tools for the AI to read and change it. Patches the installed Coopanion desktop-pet body.js with backups, restore and auto re-apply after app updates; unknown code is refused rather than guessed. Author: funst (QQ 2674459204), MIT.

scripts.test: node test/policy.test.mjs && node test/patch.test.mjs && node test/engine.test.mjs && node test/world.test.mjs
